title: Noon and Midnight
label: ch:ml-noon-and-midnight
canDo: I can say noon and midnight in Malayalam and hear paathi, 'half', inside paathira.

payoff.summary: Say ucca as "the peak" and say why it is likely a different Sanskrit root rather than a native one, then say pāthira, pull pāthi out of it, and show it is a native half-word rather than Sanskrit ardha.
payoff.note: ML-C17-paathira is the chapter's last lesson and assesses all three atoms it introduces: noon as ucca (ML-C17-ucha-paathira) and midnight as pātirā.
